name: Thomas the Rich Young Ruler
background: A young man of great wealth who ran up to Jesus and asked what he must do to inherit eternal life. He left grieving, unable to give up his riches.

genericReactions.physical: My possessions are many. This is but one of them.
genericReactions.testimonial: He told me to sell everything. I could not do it.
genericReactions.digital: My accounts are in order. I have kept the commandments.
genericReactions.environmental: I have great wealth. What more is required?
genericReactions.analytical: He said it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom. I am beginning to understand.
genericReactions.prophecy: He spoke of treasure in heaven. I chose the treasure I could see.
